title: Quantum-inspired methods for finite-element discretizations of the high-dimensional Poisson equation
summary: In recent years, quantum linear system algorithms have been applied to partial differential equations (PDEs), particularly in high-dimensional settings, demonstrating an exponential speedup in dimension. Concurrently, randomized and quantum-inspired classical linear solvers have emerged, showing computational complexity comparable to their quantum counterparts in many application areas. In this paper, we investigate the applicability of these quantum-inspired classical algorithms to PDEs.
